data.name: Maisaa
data.long_meaning: The name Maisaa is derived from the Arabic language and is mentioned in the Quran as the name of the mother of Prophet Zachariah (Al-Zakariya). She was known for her strong faith and devotion to Allah, making her an inspiration for Muslims. When her husband, Imran, was old and unable to have children, Maisaa prayed to Allah for a child. Allah granted her request and she gave birth to Prophet Zachariah, who grew up to become a great prophet and a messenger of Allah.
